capabilities: underline grammar and spelling mistakes while typing
apply suggested corrections from a click menu
ignore rules or add words to a personal dictionary
check notes on demand via ribbon, command, or status bar
run checking through a local server, remote server, or bundled offline engine
extras: README warns the plugin is vibecoded with little human review and may break or mangle text; it is not in the community catalogue and must be installed manually. More contributor detail is in AGENTS.md.
problem: Obsidian's built-in spellcheck flags unknown words only and offers no grammar checking or French-specific rules.

relations.evidence: French grammar and spell checking inside Obsidian, powered by Grammalecte.

requires.name: Grammalecte engine (local or remote server, or bundled engine download)

summary: French grammar and spell checker that underlines mistakes in the editor, powered by the Grammalecte engine through local, remote, or bundled offline backends.
